assumptions.statement: Current core theory may constrain an admissible constitutive family without selecting one exact member; D4-v2 may select a bounded revision-specific member after pressure, while interface requirements alone are not promoted to derivations.
Candidate-local typing is performed on one fixed-topology smooth stratum; this local analysis does not make topology globally fixed in GRC9V4.
The initial common K_4 profile is assembled from declared finite-radius graph-local stalk contributions; arbitrary dense graph-global coupling is outside this gate.
Candidate B stores metric-typed T_B with the same bilinear-form units as H_1_pre; only Theta_B = H_1_pre^(-1/2) T_B H_1_pre^(-1/2) is dimensionless.
The initial Candidate C profile uses only the state-level spatial retained sector and excludes the branch-relative dynamic sector from runtime authority.

Candidate C prepares its selector from the declared pre-read geometry h_4_pre on a fixed-rank separated spectral stratum; this is a bounded candidate staging choice rather than a universal theory result.

The initial Candidate C selector is the H_0_pre-orthogonal low spectral projector of the declared self-adjoint weighted graph scalar Laplacian at a preregistered cutoff Lambda_C with a strict gap and no-flux closed-profile boundary convention.

Candidate C's dimensionless retained-read-geometry gain kappa_M_C belongs only to H_M; the global structural route remains the source-backed retained-mediated current-tensor path after inverse_I_4M_pre returns j_C_M to the common physical one-form representation and no direct T_C-to-K_4 gain is admitted.
The common H_4 map is intentionally deferred to D7G and no candidate-local read geometry may be relabelled as physical h_4.

source_claim_register.claim: The core primitive state remains C and J_C; read-back projectors and operators do not automatically authorize an independent primitive carrier.
T_C equals the state-level spatial retained sector P_M_Delta[C,h,cutoff] C and is not an independent resource or serialized state.
The dynamic slow sector is branch-relative analytical data and cannot become runtime authority without a separate D1-compatible admission.
The source gives h_M schematically as a function of retained sector and C but explicitly leaves the exact map open.

Given regular h_4_pre and h_M, the canonical one-form identification is I_4M_pre = h_M_flat composed with h_4_pre_sharp and its inverse returns h_M-represented current to the common physical h_4_pre one-form representation.
The exact global metric closure g[K], represented here by H_4, remains open and has no universal reinforcement or softening sign.

The accepted source set admits B as a revision-level independent nonresource possibility without uniquely selecting its graph type or G_B; this permits but does not uniquely determine a constrained V4 constitutive completion.
